Claude: current-basis author refresh of #20047, retaining its full A/B outcome, performer, destination, conditions and adopted authority. The completed deployment correction has cleared its predecessor; this is your next source delivery, followed by #20084, #20664 and #20819.

The [current CLI](cmd/gs/main.go@8ae7bd8fe684c55b404aaab28fc7e96ecd1d1b55:2691) still treats #N as display-only, while [MCP basis disclosure](cmd/gitseq-mcp/main.go@07753351d69c05dedec58f4e2561a793054312a5:1751) already exists. Both files and the [architecture contract](docs/reference/architecture.md@b23c0263033b1d57e7a493d7c30b1ea6c53b980c:1) match current main byte-for-byte. Preserve #19996 ineffective-support disclosure, now landed. The [original evidence](http://127.0.0.1:7777/#/thread/git%3Asha1%3A5d2622748872b7e2dec3fe5c59e4be73a35e0bc8%23git%3Asha1%3A50cd7fd1f73451c37df62a7b92806b00fd72fa0e?preview_event=git%3Asha1%3A5d2622748872b7e2dec3fe5c59e4be73a35e0bc8%23git%3Asha1%3A50cd7fd1f73451c37df62a7b92806b00fd72fa0e&evidence=reference-recovery-evidence.json) remains available at its original signed event; [current basis checks](reference-current-bases.json) record the refresh.

Proposal #13520 and Hugh adoption e0766916 remain effective. Ordinary inherited staleness is retained honestly; no provenance edge has been removed to make a row look fresh. The original conditions below are copied verbatim, including both remaining features and all delivery gates. This refresh does not reopen completed predecessor work or alter any other promised outcome. The old request will be explicitly retired in favor of this successor; its historical promise is preserved, without maker withdrawal.

body.conditions:
Deliver both remaining parts of adopted proposal d54de200, with the current-source reconciliation below, through exact independent review and sealed main delivery. Queue after your promised deployment-note correction #20009, without interrupting #19996/#20008 or Tailapp I7. Begin a new request/event-reference-inputs worktree from then-current main. Answer with a promise/queue or a specific viability explanation. If an existing implementation assignment or later adopted disposition is identified, name it before duplicating work; a real successor takes precedence over this audit's bounded absence finding.

A. At CLI and MCP human-input boundaries, accept the workroom's actual displayed #N event number and unambiguous event-hash prefixes or suffixes. Resolve only against the selected verified durable event set, never arbitrary Git objects or another room by inference. Canonical IDs remain accepted, with current object-format handling. Inventory every event-reference-bearing input, including rests_on, targets, read selectors, review/merge/artifact references and typed event-reference body fields/batch entries; share one resolver and avoid per-reference log scans. Do not reinterpret actor fingerprints, ordinary implementation heads, ephemeral handles, free prose or already-signed records. Store/sign only full canonical IDs. Deduplicate the same event matched by prefix and suffix; ambiguous/no-match selectors refuse with bounded useful candidates and no append. Resolve against one coherent verified frontier before signing, show each resolved canonical ID on writes without corrupting the CLI's single-ID stdout contract, and ensure races or cache/fallback paths never sign a different event silently. Preserve explicit cross-workroom canonical references, current sequence numbering and kernel/fold semantics. Update command/tool guidance so users can paste what the UI displays. Include SHA-1/SHA-256, boundary-number, collision, unrelated-blob, wrong-room, batch and CLI/MCP parity controls, plus assertions on actual signed canonical payloads and no-append refusals. Avoid a new general cache, state machine or speculative index when the existing verified projection can supply the lookup.

B. Finish the adopted author-visible unresolved-basis warning where it is still absent. Current main MCP already emits unresolved_rests_on; reuse/preserve that behavior and make ordinary CLI filing disclose unresolved/malformed bases, with pre-sign author feedback and post-submit actual-result diagnostics as specified by13520. Distinguish malformed input and local nonexistence from an explicit external canonical citation that this room cannot verify. New #N/hash selectors with no match still refuse under A. Preserve the kernel's existing refusal for a canonical local nonexistent event; do not restore the proposal's obsolete claim that it is silently admitted. Preserve the current signed staleness testimony, retired-basis override and effective-supersession advisory behavior; incorporate #19996's ineffective-support disclosure once landed. Do not convert warnings into new fold refusals or grant authority. Test malformed warning, canonical unknown refusal/no append, valid quiet control, external unresolved distinction, stderr/stdout and MCP-result agreement. No duplicate admission-policy implementation.

The effective Hugh adoption is already authority for this unchanged direction; ordinary inherited staleness is acknowledged with these current conditions. Original3690's wider removal of implementing-commit Rests-On trailers is excluded: preserve current discipline and history. If a genuinely new semantic choice is required, surface it for exact adoption before dependent implementation. Record the affected layers and update architecture, event-ID, CLI/MCP and workflow docs in the same head. Publish a concise primary artifact and exact-path companions with working file previews, request independent Codex review including Architecture/Security/Simplification and substantive omission-sensitive controls, ratify the verdict, seal the approved exact head with proper path succession, push main/workroom refs, check CI and remove owned branch/worktree. Both remaining A/B outcomes must be satisfied or explicitly disposed of under the governing authority; do not close after diagnosis or one partial feature. No history rewrite, live service operation, repository administration or #8162 work.
